name: MonarchSwitchSettingsList
title: SwitchSettingsList
wrapsNative: androidx.compose.material3.Switch in a toggleable row (the internal LabelledControlRow), androidx.compose.foundation.layout.Column, MonarchProgress while saving, MonarchButton to retry, androidx.compose.runtime.rememberCoroutineScope for the save
summary: A group of on/off settings that each save on their own, with saving, saved and failed states and a retry on the row.
whenToUse: For settings that take effect at once and must reach a server, such as notification or privacy settings.
whenNotToUse: For a switch whose value is kept on the device or submitted with a form use MonarchSwitchRow. For a choice saved with a Save button use MonarchCheckboxRow in a form with MonarchFormActionsBar.
api: @Composable public fun MonarchSwitchSettingsList(modifier: Modifier = Modifier, title: String? = null, description: String? = null, labels: MonarchSwitchSettingsListLabels = MonarchSwitchSettingsListLabels(), savedDurationMillis: Long = MonarchSwitchSettingsListDefaults.SavedDurationMillis, content: @Composable ColumnScope.() -> Unit)

@Composable public fun MonarchSwitchSettingsRow(checked: Boolean, onCheckedChange: (Boolean) -> Unit, onSave: suspend (Boolean) -> Unit, label: String, modifier: Modifier = Modifier, enabled: Boolean = true, description: String? = null, labels: MonarchSwitchSettingsListLabels? = null, onStatusChange: ((MonarchSwitchSettingsStatus) -> Unit)? = null)
public enum class MonarchSwitchSettingsStatus { Idle, Saving, Saved, Error }

public class MonarchSwitchSettingsListLabels(saving: String? = null, saved: String? = null, error: String? = null, retry: String? = null, retryLabel: ((String) -> String)? = null, errorMessage: ((Throwable) -> String?)? = null)
public object MonarchSwitchSettingsListDefaults { public const val SavedDurationMillis: Long }

options.name: modifier
options.description: List: the modifier of the list.

options.name: title
options.description: List: the heading of the group, a heading for TalkBack.

options.name: description
options.description: List: a sentence under the heading.

options.name: labels
options.description: List: replacements for "Saving", "Saved", "Couldn't save.", "Retry", the spoken retry name and the error message, for every row.

options.name: savedDurationMillis
options.description: List: how long "Saved" stays after a save.

options.name: onCheckedChange
options.description: Row: called with the new value after onSave returned; update the saved value here.

options.name: onSave
options.description: Row: saves the new value. Throwing rolls the switch back and shows the error with Retry. Cancelled when the row leaves the composition.

options.name: label
options.description: Row: the name of the setting; labels the switch.

options.name: enabled
options.description: Row: whether the user can toggle the row and retry.

options.name: description (row)
options.description: Row: what the setting does, under the label and part of the row's TalkBack text.

options.name: labels (row)
options.description: Row: replacements for this row; null properties keep the list's.

options.name: onStatusChange
options.description: Row: called when the save status changes, for example to disable a Done button while saving.

states.name: idle
states.description: The switch shows the saved value; no status line.

states.name: saving
states.description: The switch already shows the new value; a small spinner named "Saving" and "Saving" in the muted color. Further toggles are ignored.

states.name: saved
states.description: "Saved" in the strong success color for savedDurationMillis, announced.

states.name: error
states.description: The switch returns to the saved value; "Couldn't save." with the reason in the strong danger color and a Retry button that saves the failed value again. Announced, and set as the error of the row. Toggling the row again also saves again.

states.name: disabled
states.description: enabled = false: the row cannot be toggled; label and description take the disabled text color.

appearance: The switch is the Material 3 Switch in the MonarchTheme colors. Status text uses the caption type: muted for saving, strong success for saved, strong danger for an error; the description of the list is muted. The same roles apply in every theme.
platformNotes: The web has SwitchSettingsList and SwitchSettingsItem; Android, as iOS, names the row MonarchSwitchSettingsRow so it can also stand outside the list. The web's onCheckedChange returns a promise; Android splits it into onSave, a suspend function that throws on failure, and onCheckedChange, which receives the value after the save. A save that returns at once still shows "Saved", as on iOS. The web's headingLevel has no Android equivalent (the title is a heading) and the uncontrolled defaultChecked is replaced by the hoisted checked value. The status line sits under the row so it can wrap at large text sizes. The parity map names ListItem rows and lists inline-error-retry: the rows use the same toggleable row as MonarchSwitchRow instead of ListItem, so the whole row is one target, and the error is drawn with a MonarchButton because MonarchInlineErrorRetry cannot give its retry button a per-row TalkBack name and is a live region of its own, which would announce the error twice.
accessibility: Each row is one toggleable TalkBack element with the switch role, read with its label, description and on or off state.
While a save has failed, the error is set as the error of the row, so TalkBack reads it with the switch.
"Saved" and the error are announced through an always-present polite live region per row; "Saving" is not announced, and the spinner is one element named "Saving".
The retry button is a MonarchButton with a 48dp touch target named "Retry" and the row label ("Retry Weekly summary").
Status is written in words, so saved and failed do not depend on color.
The list title is a heading.
edgeCases: An exception without a message shows only "Couldn't save."; pass labels.errorMessage to turn exceptions into text, or return null to show none.
A save that is still running when the row leaves the composition is cancelled, and onCheckedChange is not called.
A new save restarts the "Saved" timer, so a late timer never clears the status of a newer save.
Long labels and descriptions wrap; the error and Retry wrap onto two lines when they do not fit.

examples.title: Notification preferences
examples.template:
MonarchSwitchSettingsList(
    title = {{title}},
    description = {{description}},
) {
    MonarchSwitchSettingsRow(
        checked = alerts,
        onCheckedChange = { alerts = it },
        onSave = { delay({{saveMillis}}L) },
        label = {{items.0.label}},
        description = {{items.0.description}},
    )
    MonarchSwitchSettingsRow(
        checked = devices,
        onCheckedChange = { devices = it },
        onSave = { delay({{saveMillis}}L) },
        label = {{items.1.label}},
        description = {{items.1.description}},
    )
    MonarchSwitchSettingsRow(
        checked = digest,
        onCheckedChange = { digest = it },
        onSave = { delay({{saveMillis}}L) },
        label = {{items.2.label}},
    )
}
examples.code:
MonarchSwitchSettingsList(
    title = "Security notifications",
    description = "Emails about activity on your account.",
) {
    MonarchSwitchSettingsRow(
        checked = alerts,
        onCheckedChange = { alerts = it },
        onSave = { delay(700L) },
        label = "Security alerts",
        description = "Password changes and new recovery methods.",
    )
    MonarchSwitchSettingsRow(
        checked = devices,
        onCheckedChange = { devices = it },
        onSave = { delay(700L) },
        label = "New device sign-in",
        description = "When your account is used on a device for the first time.",
    )
    MonarchSwitchSettingsRow(
        checked = digest,
        onCheckedChange = { digest = it },
        onSave = { delay(700L) },
        label = "Weekly summary",
    )
}

examples.title: Disable Done while a save runs
examples.setup:
var share by rememberSaveable { mutableStateOf(false) }
var status by remember { mutableStateOf(MonarchSwitchSettingsStatus.Idle) }
